Build Smarter IVR Flows with Caller Data Capture and Conditional Routing

Conversive IVR flows now support

Data Capture

and

Conditional

nodes, enabling you to collect information from callers and use that information to determine how their calls are routed. This enhancement provides greater control over IVR experiences by allowing call flows to respond dynamically to caller input.

What's New

- Capture caller information:
Use the
Data Capture
node to prompt callers to enter information during an active call.
- Store caller input:
Save captured information in a variable for use within the IVR flow.
- Configure input requirements:
Set minimum and maximum input length, input timeout, and retry attempts.
- Conditional routing:
Use a connected
Conditional
node to evaluate the captured variable.
- Route based on caller input:
Direct callers to different next steps depending on the condition result.
- Support different call outcomes:
Route callers to destinations such as a
Calling Queue
or
Disconnect
node based on the configured conditions.

How It Works

The

Data Capture

node collects information entered by the caller and stores it in a configured variable. You can control how the information is collected by defining input length limits, timeout duration, and retry attempts.

The captured variable can then be passed directly to a connected

Conditional

node. The Conditional node evaluates the caller's input against the configured condition and routes the call to the appropriate next step based on the result.

Steps to Configure

1. Open
IVR Management
    and select an IVR flow to edit.
2. Add a
Data Capture
    node to the IVR flow.
3. Configure the prompt and variable for storing the caller's input.
4. Set the
minimum and maximum input length
,
timeout
, and
retry attempts
.
5. Connect the
Data Capture
    node to a
Conditional
    node.
6. Configure the condition using the captured variable.
7. Connect the condition outcomes to the appropriate next steps, such as a
Calling Queue
    or
Disconnect
    node.
8. Save and activate the IVR flow.
9. Test the configured flow using an incoming call.

Who Benefits

- Contact Center Teams
— Route callers based on information collected during the call.
- Customer Support Teams
— Capture customer information and direct callers to the appropriate support path.
- IVR Administrators
— Build more flexible and condition-driven IVR experiences.
- Operations Teams
— Automate call routing based on caller-provided information.
- Businesses with Complex Call Flows
— Create IVR experiences that adapt to caller input and support different routing outcomes.

[See how it works →](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_ekWoOy3G_M)

Automate Recurring Pre-Recorded Voice Campaigns

Conversive now enables

recurring Pre-recorded Voice Campaigns

, allowing businesses to automate repeated voice outreach based on a configured schedule. You can also

Pause, Continue, or Abort

recurring campaigns as needed, providing greater control over campaign execution.

What's New

- Recurring Voice Campaigns:
Schedule Pre-recorded Voice Campaigns to run repeatedly based on a configured recurrence schedule.
- Flexible scheduling:
Define the campaign start date, time, end date, frequency, and time zone.
- Campaign controls:
Pause, continue, or abort recurring campaigns based on operational requirements.
- Audio template visibility:
Easily identify the pre-recorded voice template selected for a campaign from the campaign listing.
- Pre-recorded voice outreach:
Use existing audio templates to automate repeated voice communications.

How It Works

Create a

Voice Campaign

using the Voice channel and select

Recurring

as the campaign type. Choose

Pre-recorded

as the call type and select the audio template you want to use. Configure the campaign schedule by specifying the

start date, time, end date, frequency, and time zone

.

Steps to Configure

01. Open
    Campaigns
     and create a
    Voice Campaign
    .
02. Select
    Voice
     as the campaign channel.
03. Choose the required
    Voice Sender ID
    .
04. Select
    Recurring
     as the campaign type.
05. Configure the
    campaign audience
    .
06. Select
    Pre-recorded
     as the call type.
07. Search for and select the required
    audio template
    .
08. Under
    When do you want to send the campaign?
    , configure the
    start date, time, end date, frequency, and time zone
    .
09. Start the campaign.
10. Use
    Pause
    ,
    Continue
    , or
    Abort
     to manage the recurring campaign as needed.

Who Benefits

- Marketing Teams
— Automate recurring voice outreach without manually launching each campaign.
- Customer Engagement Teams
— Maintain consistent voice communication based on a defined schedule.
- Operations Teams
— Manage recurring campaign execution with flexible control options.
- Customer Support Teams
— Schedule repeated pre-recorded voice communications for customer notifications and reminders.
- Campaign Administrators
— Configure schedules, audio templates, test calls, and campaign execution from a centralized workflow.

[See how it works →](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mr_oizyDrwE)

Unify Customer Conversations Across Channels with Omnichannel Desk

Omnichannel Desk provides agents with a unified workspace to manage customer conversations across channels such as SMS, Email, and WhatsApp. Agents can also manually merge conversations that belong to the same customer, even when they are associated with different customer identities or channels, while preserving the complete conversation context.

What's New

- Unified conversation view:
View customer conversations across channels, including SMS, Email, and WhatsApp, from the Omnichannel Desk.
- Manual conversation merging:
Merge conversations that belong to the same customer, even when they are associated with different customer identities or channels.
- Complete conversation context:
View messages chronologically while retaining the original channel associated with each message.
- Easy desk switching:
Users on the Legacy Desk can select
Switch Desk (New)
to access the Omnichannel Desk. Users can also switch between
Switch Desk (New)
and
Switch Desk (Legacy)
based on their workflow.

How It Works

The Omnichannel Desk brings customer conversations from multiple channels into a single workspace. When multiple conversations belong to the same customer, agents can manually merge them into one conversation thread.

Steps to Configure

1. If you are using the
Legacy Desk
, select
Switch Desk (New)
    to open the
Omnichannel Desk
.
2. Open the conversation you want to merge.
3. Select
Merge Conversation
.
4. Choose another conversation that belongs to the same customer.
5. Review the conversations and
confirm
    the merge.
6. View the merged conversations in a single thread, with the original channel displayed for each message.

Who Benefits

- Customer Support Teams:
Manage customer interactions across multiple channels from a single workspace.
- Contact Center Agents:
Access a consolidated conversation history without switching between channels.
- Customer Engagement Teams:
Maintain conversation continuity when customers interact through different channels or identities.
- Support Managers:
Provide teams with a unified view of customer interactions and context.

[See how it works →](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MxMh0i5A1GA)

Connect Microsoft Email Accounts with Nylas for Unified Customer Conversations

Conversive now supports connecting Microsoft email accounts, including Office 365, Outlook, and Exchange, through Nylas. Users can send, receive, and reply to Microsoft emails directly from the unified conversation inbox, while incoming and outgoing messages are automatically synced to the conversation history.

What's New

- Microsoft email support:
Connect Microsoft email accounts, including
Office 365, Outlook, and Exchange
, through Nylas.
- Bidirectional email management:
Send, receive, and reply to Microsoft emails directly from the unified conversation inbox.
- Automatic conversation sync:
Incoming and outgoing Microsoft email messages are automatically added to the conversation history.
- Unified customer timeline:
Bring Microsoft email conversations into the same contact timeline as SMS, MMS, and other communication channels.

How It Works

Nylas connects your Microsoft email account to Conversive, allowing email conversations to be managed from the unified conversation inbox.

Once the Microsoft account is authenticated, incoming and outgoing email messages are synchronized automatically.

Steps to Configure

1. Go to
Integrations > Email
.
2. Select the
Microsoft / Office 365
    connector.
3. Authenticate using your
Microsoft credentials
.
4. Once connected, Microsoft email threads will begin syncing directly into your portal.
5. Manage, send, receive, and reply to Microsoft email conversations from the unified conversation inbox.

Who Benefits

- Customer Support Teams:
Manage Microsoft email conversations alongside other customer communication channels.
- Contact Center Agents:
Send, receive, and reply to emails without switching between platforms.
- Customer Engagement Teams:
Maintain a consolidated view of customer interactions across email, SMS, MMS, and other channels.
- Support Operations Teams:
Keep incoming and outgoing Microsoft email interactions synchronized within the conversation history.

[See how it works →](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MD92nOKFH5Q)

Connect Pinnacle RCS with Conversive for Rich and Interactive Messaging

Conversive now supports

Pinnacle RCS

, enabling businesses to connect their Pinnacle RCS account directly from the Integrations page. With a simple BYOP setup using a Bot ID and API Key, businesses can send rich and interactive RCS messages through their pre-registered templates.

What's New

- Pinnacle RCS integration:
Connect your Pinnacle RCS account directly from the
Integrations
page in Conversive.
- Simple BYOP setup:
Configure the integration using your
Bot ID
and
API Key
.
- Rich and interactive messaging:
Send RCS messages using your
pre-registered templates
.
- Branded customer engagement:
Use RCS to deliver richer and more interactive customer messaging alongside existing communication channels.

How It Works

The Pinnacle RCS integration uses a BYOP setup to connect your Pinnacle RCS account with Conversive.

Steps to Configure

1. Go to
Integrations
    in Conversive.
2. Select
Pinnacle RCS
    from the available providers.
3. Enter your
Bot ID
    and
API Key
.
4. Save the configuration.
5. Start sending RCS messages using your
pre-registered templates
.

Who Benefits

- Marketing Teams:
Create richer customer engagement experiences using interactive RCS messaging.
- Customer Engagement Teams:
Deliver branded RCS communications through Conversive.
- Campaign Teams:
Use pre-registered RCS templates for customer messaging.
- Businesses Using Pinnacle RCS:
Connect an existing Pinnacle RCS account with Conversive through a simple BYOP setup.

[See how it works →](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BFS-PKvvPoM)

Connect Corefactors CRM with Conversive for Automated Lead Sync

Conversive now supports direct integration with

Corefactors CRM

, allowing businesses to connect their CRM using an

API Key

and configure the

Leads

object from the integration settings. With bidirectional Lead Sync, lead data can be automatically synchronized between Corefactors CRM and Conversive, helping teams maintain consistent lead information and streamline customer engagement.

What's New

- Corefactors CRM integration:
Connect Corefactors CRM directly with Conversive using your
API Key
.
- Leads object configuration:
Configure the
Leads
object directly from the integration settings.
- Bidirectional Lead Sync:
Automatically synchronize lead data between
Corefactors CRM and Conversive
.
- Reduced manual updates:
Keep lead information consistent across both platforms without manually transferring data.

How It Works

The Corefactors CRM integration connects your CRM with Conversive using an

API Key

. After connecting the CRM, you can configure the

Leads

object and define the required sync settings.

Steps to Configure

1. Go to
Integrations
    in Conversive.
2. Select
Corefactors CRM
.
3. Enter your
API Key
    and connect your CRM.
4. Configure the
Leads
    object and sync settings.
5. Save the configuration to start syncing lead data automatically.

Who Benefits

- Sales Teams:
Keep lead information synchronized while managing customer engagement through Conversive.
- Marketing Teams:
Maintain consistent lead data across Corefactors CRM and Conversive.
- Customer Engagement Teams:
Engage with leads without manually transferring CRM data.
- CRM Administrators:
Configure the Leads object and synchronization settings directly within the integration.

[See how it works →](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hDjHpoCWzZU)

Enable Twilio Group Messaging Directly from Conversive

Admins can now enable

Group Messaging

for supported Twilio Sender IDs and phone numbers directly from the Conversive integration settings. This self-service configuration removes the need for backend setup, making it faster and easier to activate multi-participant conversations.

What's New

- Group Messaging configuration:
Enable Group Messaging directly from the
Twilio integration settings
.
- Group Messaging Enabled option:
A new configuration option is available for supported Twilio Sender IDs and phone numbers.
- Self-service activation:
Admins can activate Group Messaging without requiring additional backend configuration.
- Multi-participant conversations:
Once enabled, the selected number can be used to support group conversations.

How It Works

Admins can configure Group Messaging directly from the Conversive UI by selecting a supported Twilio Sender ID or phone number and enabling

Group Messaging Enabled

.

Once the configuration is saved, the selected number is enabled for group conversations. This eliminates the need for backend configuration and simplifies the setup process.

Steps to Configure

1. Go to
Integrations
    and search for
Twilio
.
2. Select the required
Sender ID or phone number
.
3. Enable
Group Messaging Enabled
.
4. Save the configuration.
5. The selected number can now support
group conversations
.

Who Benefits

- Conversive Administrators:
Enable Group Messaging directly without backend configuration.
- Customer Support Teams:
Support multi-participant conversations using configured Twilio numbers.
- Customer Engagement Teams:
Set up group messaging faster for collaborative customer interactions.
- Operations Teams:
Reduce setup effort by managing Group Messaging configuration directly from the Conversive UI.

Enable Two-Way SMS and MMS Messaging with Vibes Connect

Conversive now provides end-to-end

SMS and MMS support through Vibes Connect

, enabling businesses to manage outbound and inbound messaging, MMS media attachments, long and concatenated SMS messages, and delivery tracking from a unified conversational experience. Vibes-connected Sender IDs can be used across campaigns, one-to-one conversations, and AI-powered messaging workflows.

What's New

- End-to-end SMS and MMS support:
Send and receive SMS and MMS messages through Vibes Connect directly from Conversive.
- Inbound messaging:
Receive incoming SMS and MMS messages directly within conversations.
- MMS media support:
Handle media attachments such as
photos, documents, and audio
.
- Long SMS support:
Support long and concatenated SMS messages.
- Delivery tracking:
Track standardized message statuses, including
Sent, Delivered, and Failed
.
- Delivery visibility:
View message delivery status and timestamps within supported conversation and messaging views.
- Flexible Sender ID usage:
Use Vibes-connected Sender IDs across campaigns, one-to-one conversations, and AI-powered messaging workflows.

How It Works

The Vibes Connect integration enables two-way SMS and MMS communication between businesses and their customers through Conversive.

Steps to Configure

1. Configure your
Vibes Connect
    provider credentials.
2. Set up the required
Vibes Sender ID
.
3. Use the Sender ID for outbound campaigns, one-to-one conversations, or AI-powered messaging workflows.
4. Incoming SMS and MMS messages will automatically appear in
Conversive conversations
.
5. Delivery updates for outbound messages are processed automatically.
6. View message status and delivery information from the
conversation timeline
    or supported messaging analytics.

Who Benefits

- Marketing Teams:
Use Vibes-connected Sender IDs across campaigns and engage customers through SMS and MMS.
- Customer Support Teams:
Manage incoming customer replies and two-way conversations from Conversive.
- Customer Engagement Teams:
Deliver SMS and MMS messages, including media-rich communications, from a unified conversational experience.
- Campaign Teams:
Monitor message delivery statuses and timestamps for greater visibility into campaign messaging.
- AI-Powered Engagement Teams:
Use Vibes Sender IDs within AI-powered messaging workflows.

[See how it works →](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a05r9jE7uWo)

Automate AI-Powered Appointment Scheduling with Calendly

Conversive now provides a native

Calendly integration

that enables AI agents to manage appointments using real-time Calendly availability. Once connected, businesses can configure an event type and allow AI agents to help customers find available slots, schedule appointments, view upcoming bookings, and handle cancellations directly through conversational workflows.

What's New

- Native Calendly integration:
Connect your Calendly account directly with Conversive.
- Real-time availability:
AI agents can check current Calendly appointment availability.
- Booking options:
Present available appointment options to customers during conversations.
- Appointment scheduling:
Allow AI agents to schedule appointments using the configured Calendly event type.
- Upcoming bookings:
AI agents can view upcoming appointments.
- Appointment cancellations:
AI agents can handle appointment cancellations.
- Webhook synchronization:
Calendly webhooks help keep appointment information synchronized.

How It Works

The Calendly integration connects your Calendly account with Conversive using OAuth. After connecting the account, you can select the required booking event type and enable

Appointment Scheduling

.

Steps to Configure

1. Go to
Integrations
    and search for
Calendly
.
2. Click
Connect
.
3. Authenticate your Calendly account using
OAuth
.
4. Open
Modify Configuration
.
5. Select the required
booking event type
.
6. Enable
Appointment Scheduling
    for your account.
7. Configure your
AI agent
    to use appointment scheduling.

Who Benefits

- Customer Support Teams:
Help customers schedule and manage appointments directly through conversations.
- Sales Teams:
Reduce scheduling back-and-forth when coordinating customer or prospect meetings.
- Appointment-Based Businesses:
Automate appointment booking using real-time availability.
- Customer Engagement Teams:
Provide a conversational scheduling experience without manually coordinating available time slots.
- AI-Powered Service Teams:
Extend AI agent capabilities to include appointment scheduling and management.

[See how it works →](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0GVOCus-uh4)

Build Smarter Conversation Flows with Flexible Conditions and Intent Detection

Conversive now provides greater flexibility for

Conversation Flow

automation by supporting multiple Automation Entry Conditions, related CRM object fields, and

AND/OR logic

. A new

Intent Detection

node also enables conversations to be routed based on customer intent identified from previous conversation messages, making it easier to build precise and adaptable conversational workflows.

What's New

- Multiple Automation Entry Conditions:
Add multiple conditions instead of being limited to a single condition.
- AND/OR logic:
Combine conditions using
AND/OR
logic to define more precise trigger criteria.
- Related CRM object fields:
Select fields from related CRM objects when configuring Automation Entry Conditions.
- Intent Detection node:
Identify customer intent from previous conversation messages and route the conversation to the appropriate configured path.
- Default or fallback routing:
Configure a default or fallback path when no configured intent is detected.
- Backward compatibility:
Existing Conversation Flows continue to work without changes.

How It Works

When configuring a Conversation Flow, you can now define more precise Automation Entry Conditions by selecting fields from the CRM and related objects and combining multiple conditions with

AND/OR logic

.

Steps to Configure

1. Open
Conversation Flows
    and create or edit a flow.
2. Go to
Automation Entry and Post-Automation Exit Actions
    and configure the
Trigger Condition
.
3. Select the required
CRM object, field, and operator
    when defining the Automation Entry Conditions.
4. Add multiple conditions and combine them using
AND/OR
    logic as required.
5. To enable intent-based routing, add the
Intent Detection
    node to the Conversation Flow.
6. Configure the required
intents
    and their corresponding paths.
7. Configure a
default or fallback path
    for conversations where no configured intent is detected.
8. Save and publish the Conversation Flow.

Who Benefits

- Conversation Designers:
Build more precise flows using multiple conditions and flexible logic.
- Automation Teams:
Create sophisticated trigger criteria without duplicate nodes or workarounds.
- Customer Support Teams:
Route conversations based on the customer's detected intent.
- CRM Teams:
Use fields from related CRM objects when defining automation entry conditions.
- AI and Conversational Experience Teams:
Create more adaptable customer journeys with intent-based routing.

[See how it works →](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sYY4AmJXJ1o)
